data.content_ref: inline:conn:204d29004328 ABSTRACTS from all three methods (SRC_003 algebraic, SRC_004 CRT formula, SRC_005 enumeration) to the covering principle: any coprime two-congruence system x≡a mod m, x≡b mod n has a unique solution mod mn, and the smallest positive representative is found by one of three procedures—algebraic substitution with inversion, direct CRT formula evaluation, or ordered enumeration of the sparser residue class. The abstraction depends on the coprimality invariant gcd(m,n)=1. This abstraction is REFUTED IF the three methods do not actually produce the same residue class for all valid inputs—i.e., if there exists a coprime pair (m,n) and residues (a,b) where the methods diverge.
